turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not be restocked. I can't promise anything different.

I can't give medical advice, including which ointment to use. For any health question, such as a possible allergic reaction, please see a doctor.
